collections.title: Vocabulary builder
collections.blurb: Words that turn up in SAT, IELTS and admission tests. Learn the meaning, then keep it with review cards.

collections.title: Maths word problems
collections.blurb: Everyday problems solved step by step: money, time, rates, percentages.

collections.title: Quantitative reasoning
collections.blurb: Algebra, ratios, speed, profit and probability, with a worked solution for each. Great for NSU, BRAC and IBA-style tests.

collections.title: School mathematics
collections.blurb: Arithmetic, algebra, geometry and statistics at SSC/HSC level.

collections.title: Higher mathematics
collections.blurb: University-entry calculus, linear algebra and harder problem solving.

collections.title: Physics
collections.blurb: Mechanics, electricity, waves, heat and modern physics, from concepts to calculation.

collections.title: Chemistry
collections.blurb: Atoms, bonding, reactions, equilibrium, acids and organic chemistry.

collections.title: Biology
collections.blurb: Cells, genetics, physiology, anatomy and nutrition. Useful for medical admission.

collections.title: Computer science
collections.blurb: Programming logic, algorithms and how computers work.

collections.title: Economics
collections.blurb: Demand and supply, markets, money and the wider economy. Handy for BBA and economics.

collections.title: Geography
collections.blurb: People, places, climate and the world map.
